full_content: And, Then? brings together some of Improv Lore’s most experienced performers for an evening of unscripted theatre. Whether we’re revisiting a format we love or exploring something entirely new, every performance is built live with curiosity, collaboration, and a sense of play at its heart.

title: Make Friends with the Stage: Open Stage Jam by Improv Lore
excerpt: The Open Stage Jam is where you get to step in and play, and try your hand at doing some improv on stage!We’ll set up simple scenes and scenarios, guide you, and keep things moving so you’re never left figuring it out on your own. You can jump in for a scene or two, try something new, and step back whenever you like.It’s a space that’s designed to be easy to enter, and built for taking small risks. You might come in just to watch, but we're hoping you’ll leave having played.

title: The Silliest Show Tonight by Improv Lore
excerpt: A classic good ol’ improv show packed with riddles, tongue twisters, and some nostalgia. title: Whimsical Wednesday with Improv Lore
author: amehra4u

full_content:
Dive into the whimsical world of improvisation at our Wednesday Jams!
Whether you’re a novice to theatre, a maverick on stage, or just dipping your toes into the world of unscripted performance, this Jam is designed for everyone. Our facilitators will guide you through a series of engaging improv exercises, help you explore new characters, and set up scenarios that will make your inner wit shine - all on the spot!
Come as you are, leave your inhibitions at the door, and join us on this journey of endless possibility.
Bring a friend, a date, or a group - our brave space is for everyone!
